LanguageData.LP_IceRay.label: ray of frost
LanguageData.LP_IceRay.description: An active ability granted by blind sight. Deals 12 frostbite damage to a target within 24 cells, and living targets gain an extra 0.12 hypothermia. Cooldown 8 seconds. Costs no psyfocus and needs no psylink. Mechanoids and undead bodies are unaffected by hypothermia.
